messages:
lumen_poc_contact: Heads up 9: our POC client keeps failing to parse SSE streams. They get partial JSON payloads and then the socket closes. Happens after several KBs, intermittently (~1-3x / min).

mia_sales: OK thanks. Hosted or Dedicated for this trial? Are there any visible request ids in the client logs?

lumen_poc_contact: Hosted (eu-west), no request ids in client logs. Client reports `SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input`. We also saw occasional 429s from our edge.

priya_se: Which SDK / polyfill? Some polyfills don't reassemble split UTF-8 across chunks.

lumen_poc_contact: Using JS EventSource polyfill in Node. Here's a minimal curl capture we ran around the time of a failure:

```
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/stream-id"
> GET /v1/streams/stream-id HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.ai
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< Content-Type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
< Transfer-Encoding: chunked
< X-RateLimit-Limit: 60
< X-RateLimit-Remaining: 57
< X-RateLimit-Reset: 1710000000
{ [2048 bytes data]
* connection #0 to host api.redwood.ai left intact
```

But sometimes the streamed body looks truncated like:
```
data: {"id":987,"text":"partial text chunk narrows off"
```
then the upstream/proxy closes the socket. Client error stack: `EventSourcePolyfill -> parseEvent -> JSON.parse` failing.

nina_infra: The proxy log shows `upstream_write() returned 0` and then `502 while reading upstream` around that timestamp, which usually means the upstream worker dropped the connection. Two likely areas: proxy buffering/coalescing, or an upstream token-bucket/ratelimit triggered a hard reset.

ethan_engineer: Also consider idle timeout on the edge. Our SSE runtime sends heartbeat newlines every 30s. If the proxy idle timeout is lower, it may close while the client expects streaming. We can either increase proxy timeouts or add more frequent heartbeats (15s).

priya_se: On the client side, recommend the polyfill assemble until the SSE event terminator ("\n\n") before JSON.parse, and tolerate partial chunks. Add exponential backoff on abrupt close/429. We'll send a code snippet.

mia_sales: Can we do a quick hosted-side mitigation while we dig? Customer needs stable demo today.

nina_infra: Yes 1: I can push a canary override for that org in eu-west: set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_read_timeout 180s; send_timeout 180s;` and ensure `X-Accel-Buffering off` for the SSE route.

[~6 minutes later]

nina_infra: Canary applied for org lumen-poc in eu-west. Please retest and report timing windows.

lumen_poc_contact: Retested immediately: 0 failures in first 8 attempts (previously ~3/10 failed). We'll run a 2-hour soak and update. Thanks for the fast change.

support_oncall: As a traceability improvement, we should add an `X-Request-Id` header on streaming responses and log it in the event payload so we can tie broken events to edge logs. Can engineering add a short-term debug header?

ethan_engineer: Good idea. I'll add an internal ticket to emit `X-Request-Id` and an optional short-heartbeat toggle for the streaming runtime. Also investigating edge logs 1: I see bursts of `upstream_write() returned 0` coincident with multiple simultaneous streams from the same org. Looks like the edge token-bucket for that org bumped and returned reset behavior rather than graceful throttling. We should ensure throttles return 429 with graceful keepalive, not RST.

mial_sales: (note) We should offer them a short Dedicated trial to avoid noisy neighbors during the POC. I'll follow up on pricing if the soak shows improvement.

lumen_poc_contact: Appreciate it. Canary seems to help. We'll confirm after the soak.

support_oncall: Follow-ups / ACTIONS:
- infra: retain canary config for 48h and collect 502/5xx metrics for lumen org
- eng: ticket to add `X-Request-Id` to SSE responses + optional 15s heartbeat toggle
- solutions: send recommended polyfill snippet and reconnection strategy to customer
- sales: prepare Dedicated trial pricing option as short-term mitigation

logbot: Created ticket SF-4987 to track streaming-request-id and heartbeat work, linked to lumen POC.

lumen_poc_contact: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:. We'll report back after the 2-hour soak window.
